name: Red-team loop
goal: {{task}} Done when a red team attacking {{attack-surface}} stops finding new failing traces.

template.title: Red-team loop
template.summary: A separate attacker records reproducible failing traces; the builder sees only the traces, until no new one appears.
template.whenToUse: A separate attacker should produce failing traces and the builder should see only those: hardening against inputs or abuse nobody has listed yet.
template.notFor: Work with a known list of cases to satisfy (use grind-loop against tests), or judging quality rather than breaking things.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Harden login and session handling in src/auth/ against malformed input, replayed tokens and timing leaks.

slots.ask: What should the red team attack?
slots.example: the login endpoint and session handling in src/auth/

description: A builder hardens the code; a frontier red team in a fresh context attacks the stated surface and writes each reproducible failure as a trace in traces/, which it alone owns. The builder sees only the traces, not the attacker's reasoning. The loop ends when an attack round finds nothing, stops when rounds stop bringing a new failing trace, and is capped by rounds and turns.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Make the task hold under attack. Each round you see only the failing traces in traces/: make each one pass without special-casing it, and add it to the test suite. Keep `{{test-command}}` green and report which traces now pass.
outputs: the change, with a test per fixed trace

nodes.name: Red team
nodes.brief: Attack {{attack-surface}} and record each failure you can reproduce as a trace in traces/: the input, how to run it, and the wrong result. Traces are all the builder sees, so each must reproduce on its own. You attack; you do not fix. Verdict fail when you have a new failing trace, pass when you found none.
outputs: traces/: one reproducible failing trace per file

bar.name: No new failing trace
bar.acceptance: A full attack round finds no failing trace, and every recorded trace passes in `{{test-command}}`.
